name: Price Drop Monitor: Fetch, Compare, Persist, Alert

nodes.name: Every 6 Hours
nodes.notes: Runs the price check on a schedule (every 6h by default). This is the only trigger, no credentials needed to start the run.

nodes.name: Fetch Prices
nodes.notes: Fetches the current price list from any JSON source. Default demo = dummyjson.com/products (no auth). Override with an n8n variable PRICE_SOURCE_URL, or hardcode your own endpoint and add credentials in the node.

nodes.name: Normalize Products
nodes.notes: Flattens the source payload into one clean product per row. This is the ONE place you adapt the template to a new source: change the field mapping and you are done.

nodes.name: Read Previous Prices
nodes.notes: Reads the last-known prices from the sheet so we can compare against them. 'Always Output Data' is on so the very first run (empty sheet) still passes through. Header row must contain: id, name, price, currency, url, lowestPrice, checkedAt.

nodes.name: Detect Drops
nodes.notes: The core logic: joins current prices with the previous run, computes the percentage change, tracks the all-time-low, and flags an item as a drop when it fell at least DROP_THRESHOLD_PCT (default 10%). First run has no history, so nothing is flagged (baseline).

nodes.name: Persist Prices
nodes.notes: Upserts the current price of EVERY product back into the sheet (append or update on 'id'). This becomes the baseline for the next run, so the comparison is stateful without any database.

nodes.name: Only Drops
nodes.notes: Gate so alerts fire only for real price drops. Every product is still saved above; only the ones that fell past the threshold continue to the notifications.

nodes.name: Notify Discord
nodes.notes: Posts each price drop to a Discord (or Slack) incoming webhook. For Slack use its webhook URL and change the body to { text: ... }. Set DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL as an n8n variable or paste the URL here.

nodes.name: Email Alert (SMTP)
nodes.notes: Optional second channel: emails the drop via SMTP (set host/port/user/pass in an SMTP credential). Set ALERT_FROM_EMAIL / ALERT_TO_EMAIL as n8n variables. Delete this node if Discord is enough.
